description: Emergency service businesses whose owner has switched on 'on call' right now (for a few hours at a time), nearest first, within a distance of a ZIP code or a point. Few owners use it yet: when none is on call, use search_businesses with emergency_now, which also covers posted 24/7 emergency service.
